exec: pm.test("Created UUID", () => { const id = pm.response.json().id; pm.expect(id).to.match(/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/); pm.environment.set("recipeId", id); });
pm.test("Cuisses de canard confites icon", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().quantities.find(item => item.name === "Cuisses de canard confites").icon).to.equal("meat"));
pm.test("Graisse de canard icon", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().quantities.find(item => item.name === "Graisse de canard").icon).to.equal("other"));
pm.test("Valid Bearer", () => { const token = pm.response.json().accessToken; pm.expect(token).to.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/); pm.environment.set("accessToken", token); });

pm.test("Profile persisted", () => { const profile = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(profile.bio).to.eql("Profil de test HTTP"); pm.expect(profile.avatar).to.match(/^\/me\/avatar\//); pm.environment.set("avatarPath", profile.avatar.split('/').pop()); });
pm.test("Valid Bearer", () => { const token = pm.response.json().accessToken; pm.expect(token).to.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/); pm.environment.set("accessToken", token); });

pm.test("Scaled quantity", () => { const data = pm.response.json(); const item = data.find(item => item.name === "Feuilles de lasagne"); pm.expect(item.amount).to.equal(6); pm.expect(item.checked).to.equal(false); pm.collectionVariables.set("planningItem", item.id); });

pm.test("Five recipe ingredients", () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.lengthOf(5); pm.collectionVariables.set("planningItems", JSON.stringify(data.map(item => item.id))); });

pm.test("Recipe provenance", () => { const item = pm.response.json().find(item => item.name === "Feuilles de lasagne"); pm.expect(item.contributions).to.deep.equal([{ recipeId: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", recipeTitle: "Lasagnes à la bolognaise maison", amount: 6 }]); });
pm.test("Checked item persisted", () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.find(item => item.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("planningItem")).checked).to.equal(true); });
pm.test("Shopping list is empty", () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.lengthOf(0); });
pm.test("Plan ID", () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.id).to.match(/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/); pm.collectionVariables.set("plannedMeal", data.id); });

pm.test("Meal details", () => { const data = pm.response.json(); const meal = data.find(item => item.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("plannedMeal")); pm.expect(meal.servings).to.equal(6); pm.expect(meal.date).to.equal("2031-01-07"); pm.expect(meal.title).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Meal is outside the week", () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.some(item => item.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("plannedMeal"))).to.equal(false); });
pm.test("Meal is removed", () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.some(item => item.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("plannedMeal"))).to.equal(false); });
pm.test("Saved note", () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.note).to.equal("Préparer la sauce la veille."); });
pm.test("Empty note", () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.note).to.equal(""); });
pm.test("Shopping list is empty", () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.have.lengthOf(0); });
